originalTitle: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Monday
simplifiedContent: Here's a simple explanation of the news: The Indian stock market went up on Friday, with two important indexes, Sensex and Nifty, increasing by more than 0.3%. This happened because the situation in the Middle East became less tense, and people think the US Federal Reserve might not increase interest rates as much as expected. Additionally, positive events in India, such as a meeting between India and Japan and improvements in the IT sector, also helped the market go up. This is important because it can affect the value of the stocks you own or want to buy. It may also influence how the market will perform on the next trading day, which is Monday.

originalTitle: Tips from Britain's ‘Own Buffett’: Timeless investing lessons for building long-term wealth
simplifiedContent: A well-known investor from Britain, Anthony Bolton, is sharing his tips on how to invest successfully in the stock market. He believes that having the right mindset and being able to control your emotions are more important than being extremely intelligent. Bolton's approach to investing involves doing your own research, understanding the companies you invest in, and being patient. He also thinks it's crucial to know when to sell your investments and to look for high-quality companies at fair prices. By following these principles, Bolton has achieved impressive returns of nearly 20% per year, making his advice worth considering for those looking to build long-term wealth.

originalTitle: Cube Highways Trust plans Rs 5,000-cr IPO this month; eyes broader investor base
simplifiedContent: Cube Highways Trust is planning to raise Rs 5,000 crore through an Initial Public Offering (IPO) this month. This means they want to sell shares to the public to collect a large amount of money. The trust owns 27 highways across India and wants to use the IPO to attract more investors and make it easier for people to buy and sell its shares. By doing this, the trust hopes to grow and provide regular returns to its investors. This IPO is significant because it will give more people the opportunity to invest in the trust and own a part of its highway assets.

originalTitle: Upcoming IPOs: Kusumgar IPO, Laser Power & Infra IPO among new issues scheduled for next week; check list here
simplifiedContent: Some companies are planning to sell their shares to the public for the first time, which is called an Initial Public Offering (IPO). Next week, companies like Kusumgar and Laser Power & Infra are going to do this, and they hope to raise a total of over ₹1,392 crore. Additionally, smaller companies like Happy Steels and Devson Catalyst are also doing IPOs, aiming to raise up to ₹67.34 crore. This matters because it gives investors a chance to buy shares in these companies and potentially earn money if they do well. These IPOs are scheduled to open next week, allowing investors to participate and buy shares.

originalTitle: Expert view: Q1FY27 results likely to remain muted, recovery from Q2 onwards, says Vinod Nair
simplifiedContent: An expert named Vinod Nair thinks that the first quarter of the financial year 2027 will have weak results, but things will start to get better from the second quarter onwards. This is happening even though the market is currently a bit unpredictable. Despite this, the overall feeling in the market is still positive. Some investors are selling their stocks to make a profit, but others are buying stocks that haven't done well so far this year. This means that there are still some good opportunities for investors to find undervalued stocks.

originalTitle: Mcap of 6 of top-10 most valued firms surges by  ₹1 lakh crore; Airtel, Bajaj Finance top gainers
simplifiedContent: This week, the Indian stock market had a good run, with the main indexes (BSE Sensex and NSE Nifty) going up by 0.86% and 0.89% respectively. This means that the overall value of the stocks in these indexes increased. The total value of six out of the top 10 biggest companies in the market rose by a huge amount, ₹1 lakh crore. Airtel and Bajaj Finance were the biggest winners, with their stock prices going up the most. This is important because it shows that investors are confident in these companies and the overall market, which can be a good sign for people who have invested their money in the stock market.
